summaries.en: The Claude Tag guide for startups explains how leading startups leverage the tool to accelerate product development and scale operations efficiently. It highlights practical applications and benefits, demonstrating how the technology streamlines workflows and enhances productivity for growing businesses. The guide serves as a resource for startups seeking to optimize their processes and achieve faster time-to-market.

items.title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
items.content: Introducing self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. Now you can run agents in your own environment, whether that’s in your own cloud or on-premise. You host the agents, credentials, and session history, and choose where requests to Claude are sent.

items.title: The components of agent memory
items.content: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what's worth remembering before it knows what's next. Here's how "dreaming" helps it organize memory and correct mistakes.
items.contentSnippet: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what's worth remembering before it knows what's next. Here's how "dreaming" helps it organize memory and correct mistakes.

summaries.zh: Claude通过“梦境”来组织记忆并纠正错误，从而在体验中学习。它需要在知道下一步之前决定哪些信息值得记忆。这一过程有助于其优化记忆结构，提升学习效率。
summaries.en: Claude utilizes "dreaming" to organize memory and correct mistakes, enabling it to learn from experience. The process involves deciding what is worth remembering before determining the next steps. This helps Claude improve its performance by structuring and refining its memory over time.

items.summary: Claude通过“梦境”来组织记忆并纠正错误，从而在体验中学习。它需要在知道下一步之前决定哪些信息值得记忆。这一过程有助于其优化记忆结构，提升学习效率。

items.title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
items.content: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that works for you, even while you’re away. It builds on two layers of protection: safety training in the Claude model itself and the safeguards that exist in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. On top of those, we added new protections for working across your accounts and acting on your behalf.
items.contentSnippet: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that works for you, even while you’re away. It builds on two layers of protection: safety training in the Claude model itself and the safeguards that exist in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. On top of those, we added new protections for working across your accounts and acting on your behalf.

summaries.zh: Claude Duet是一款能在用户离线时仍主动工作的智能代理。它基于Claude模型的安全训练和Claude Code、Claude Managed Agents等产品中的保护措施，构建了双重安全防护。此外，还增加了跨账户协作和代为执行任务的新防护机制，以提升安全性。
summaries.en: Claude Duet is a proactive agent designed to operate independently, even when users are absent. It incorporates dual layers of protection: safety training within the Claude model and existing safeguards in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. Additional new safeguards have been implemented to enhance cross-account collaboration and authorized actions on behalf of users. The system prioritizes security, privacy, and user control through these combined measures.

items.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
items.content: We need ways to prove that code is free of bugs. Formal software verification could provide this guarantee.
items.contentSnippet: We need ways to prove that code is free of bugs. Formal software verification could provide this guarantee.

summaries.zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）使大规模形式化软件验证成为可能。形式化软件验证能够为代码无错误提供保证。
summaries.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are enabling formal software verification at a larger scale, addressing the need to prove code is free of bugs. Formal verification traditionally faces scalability challenges, but LLMs help overcome these limitations, making it more feasible to ensure software reliability. The approach leverages LLM capabilities to enhance the verification process, offering a promising solution for bug-free code assurance.

items.summary: 大型语言模型（LLMs）使大规模形式化软件验证成为可能。形式化软件验证能够为代码无错误提供保证。
